answer: Each epoch, a falcon watcher is paired with one alias and reads its job receipts, confirming at least one finished job with a distinct requester. An alias with no confirmed job for 3 epochs in a row is frozen for 6 epochs and pays a 25 POA thaw fee. Watchers earn 6 POA per epoch, but a watcher who confirms a fake alias loses 20 POA and its seat for 10 epochs. A comet trail gives a fake alias away: many jobs started, none finished. So do aliases that wander from job to job and never deliver. Every freeze is published, so a farm of 20 fake aliases pays 20 thaw fees at once.
